text.tspan: Global number of reported natural disasters by the number of deaths
The number of disaster events reported in the EM-DAT disaster database, broken down by the size of the
event, in terms of deaths. There has been an increase in the number of the smallest events – with over 200
deaths – at least partly due to improvements in recording over time.

tspan.tspan: Data includes disasters reported up to April 2026.
